about: Verdict benchmark. Hand-written proposals (paraphrased, no PEP text copied, no PEP numbers) with the verdict a typing practitioner would give. Written and frozen before the system was run on them. Disjoint from the golden tests (tests/test_reasoner.py) and from examples/, which were used for tuning. `also_acceptable` is set only where typing history supports two readings.

cases.text: Let a method declare that it returns an instance of whatever class it was called on, so fluent method chains keep the subclass type.
cases.source: PEP 673 (Self Type), Final

cases.text: A user-written predicate function should be able to narrow a value's type in both the positive and the negative branch of an if statement.
cases.source: PEP 742 (Narrowing types with TypeIs), Final

cases.text: Provide a decorator that marks a function or class as deprecated so that type checkers report a warning wherever it is used.
cases.source: PEP 702 (Marking deprecations using the type system), Final

cases.text: Libraries like ORMs should be able to tell type checkers that their base class or decorator creates dataclass-like classes with a synthesized __init__.
cases.source: PEP 681 (Data Class Transforms), Final

cases.text: Let a decorator's type preserve the exact parameter list of the function it wraps, so that the wrapper is checked with the same arguments.
cases.source: PEP 612 (Parameter Specification Variables), Final

cases.text: Allow calling a generic function with explicit type arguments in square brackets, for example make_list[int]().
cases.source: PEP 718 (Subscriptable functions), Draft

cases.text: Add a ReadOnly qualifier for class attributes and protocol members, so type checkers reject assignment to them after initialization.
cases.source: PEP 767 (Annotating Read-Only Attributes), Draft

cases.text: Make the TYPE_CHECKING flag available without importing the typing module, as a built-in constant.
cases.source: PEP 781 (Make TYPE_CHECKING a built-in constant), Draft

cases.text: Allow attaching a docstring to a type alias declared with the type statement so documentation tools can show it.
cases.source: PEP 846 (Docstrings for Type Aliases), Draft

cases.text: Allow keyword arguments inside square-bracket subscripts, such as grid[1, 2, axis=0], and pass them to __getitem__.
cases.source: PEP 637 (Support for indexing with keyword arguments), Rejected

cases.text: Give dataclasses.field a converter argument that transforms the value passed to the generated __init__ before it is stored.
cases.source: PEP 712 (Adding a converter parameter to dataclasses.field), Rejected

cases.text: Document individual function parameters by putting a documentation object inside Annotated metadata instead of the docstring.
cases.source: PEP 727 (Documentation in Annotated Metadata), Withdrawn

cases.text: Change the semantics of user-defined type guards so they are strict and also narrow in the else branch, instead of adding a new construct.
cases.source: PEP 724 (Stricter Type Guards), Withdrawn in favour of PEP 742 (a new form), so 'already exists' via 742 is also defensible

cases.text: Treat every class as a structural protocol by default, so any object with matching methods is accepted wherever that class is expected.
cases.source: PEP 544, Rejected Ideas: 'Make every class a protocol by default'

cases.text: Declare generic type parameters with angle brackets, like class Box<T>, the way Java and TypeScript do.
cases.source: PEP 695, Rejected Ideas: 'Angle Brackets' (also PEP 484: 'Which brackets for generic type parameters?')

cases.text: Let the new type parameter syntax mark covariance and contravariance explicitly with in and out keywords.
cases.source: PEP 695, Rejected Ideas: 'Explicit Variance'

cases.text: Make isinstance(x, list[int]) check at runtime that every element of the list is an int.
cases.source: PEP 585, Rejected Alternatives: 'Making isinstance(obj, list[str]) perform a runtime type check'

cases.text: Add an intersection type so an argument can be required to satisfy two protocols at once.
cases.source: PEP 544, Rejected/Postponed Ideas: 'Provide a special intersection type construct'

cases.text: Let a ParamSpec be constrained so that the captured parameters must all be keyword-only.
cases.source: No PEP proposes this; it builds on PEP 612

cases.text: Allow Literal types to contain float values such as Literal[0.5], not only ints, strings, bytes, bools and enums.
cases.source: PEP 586 restricts Literal's parameters; no PEP proposes floats

cases.text: Allow NewType to wrap a union so that a distinct nominal type can be made from int | str.
cases.source: No PEP proposes this; NewType comes from PEP 484

cases.text: Generate a function's overloads automatically from a mapping of Literal argument values to return types instead of writing each @overload.
cases.source: No PEP proposes this; it combines overloads (PEP 484) and Literal (PEP 586)

cases.text: Add a modern asynchronous HTTP client with connection pooling to the standard library.
cases.source: Not a typing proposal

cases.text: Make the global interpreter lock optional through a build-time flag so threads can run in parallel.
cases.source: Not a typing proposal (PEP 703 is outside the typing corpus)

cases.text: Speed up dictionary lookups by caching hash values of string keys inside the interpreter.
cases.source: Not a typing proposal

cases.text: Introduce lazily evaluated f-strings for logging calls so formatting only happens when the message is emitted.
cases.source: Not a typing proposal
